content: The American Diabetes Association (ADA) recommends that prolonged periods of sedentary behavior should be interrupted regularly to promote better blood glucose control and overall health. For individuals living with type 1 or type 2 diabetes, engaging in simple activities such as standing up or performing light stretching exercises every 30 minutes can offer significant metabolic advantages. These actions may also help lower the risk of complications that are commonly associated with extended durations of inactivity.
